title: Deliciu V2 Pineapple Orange 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Deliciu V2 Pineapple Orange Nic Salt is a tropical delight that perfectly pairs the juicy sweetness of pineapple with the bright, citrusy zing of orange. The combination of these two bold fruit flavours creates a vibrant and refreshing e-liquid that’s bursting with flavour, offering a balanced and satisfying vape for fruit lovers. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The enhanced formulation ensures smoothness and rich flavour with every puff. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nicotine salts provide rapid nicotine relief and a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase e-liquids. The Deliciu V2 range from Vaporesso revamps the original line up of bestselling flavours with a heightened focus on quality and flavour precision, delivering improved profiles based on customer feedback. Designed for compatibility with a wide range of low-powered MTL devices, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts deliver exceptionally authentic flavours and consistent, enjoyable vaping.
